notify.ap_already.back: This appointment has already been processed

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; the previous entry "{}" stayed in the calendar. Delete it.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: The call was recognized as advertising, so the appointment set during the call was cancelled: {}
notify.ap_sales_voided.note: 'sales call' rendered as an advertising call (рекламный звонок)

notify.ap_sms_busy.back: the same SMS is already being sent

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: an SMS cannot be sent to this number, call back yourself

notify.ap_sms_no.back: Sorry, {} won't suit me after all. Can we pick another time?

notify.ap_sms_off.back: will not be sent ("SMS to the caller" is turned off in settings)
notify.ap_sms_off.note: Names the setting as «SMS звонившему»; check against the real screen label

notify.ap_sms_old_app.back: the app on the phone is too old to send SMS

notify.ap_sms_timeout.back: the phone did not respond (time ran out)

notify.ap_sms_will.back: will be sent when you press "Accept" or "Decline"

notify.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller never confirmed the repeated time; clarify with them before replying

notify.ap_void_failed.back: The appointment "{}" from the call was cancelled, but it could not be deleted from the calendar. Delete it yourself.

notify.ap_web_label.note: 'Confirm on the web' rendered as confirm in the browser

notify.ap_what.note: Row label 'What'; Что may read short next to an appointment title

notify.bl_announced_hint.back: number from the blacklist: a message was played, then the call was ended (without AI)

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: number from the blacklist: declined while the call was ringing (without AI)

notify.bl_declined_reply.back: declined while the call was ringing: nobody picked up (without AI)

notify.cw_end_hint.back: call waiting: the phone was busy with another call and declined this one (without AI)

notify.cw_matter.back: came in during another call; the phone declined it as busy{sim}

notify.f_callback_no_number.back: No number to call back: the task has no contact, and the caller's number is empty.

notify.f_callback_send_failed.back: Failed to send the callback command

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: A callback is scheduled, but the phone is not currently connected to Bageo. Make sure the phone is connected to Bageo and confirm again.

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The callback number is not on the white list. Add it (or the beginning of the number with an asterisk at the end) in settings and confirm again.

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task sends an email, but there is no reply address. Add a contact from the transcript or ignore the task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail is not set up. Enter the Gmail address and app password in settings and confirm again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: Failed to pass the task to OpenClaw: {} (check the OpenClaw address and token in settings)
notify.f_openclaw_failed.note: 'token' is the OpenClaw token, translated as a normal word; check the screen label

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address looks wrong. Check it in settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient address looks wrong

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in settings (it is never shown anywhere).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: The AI answered the call and talked; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: The AI could not connect; the system hung up, the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: The AI failed; the call went to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: a refusal message was played, then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: number from the blacklist: an unavailability message was played, then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system considered the call advertising or fraud ({t}); stalling the conversation is turned off, so the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: at first the system took the call for advertising or fraud; a second check showed an ordinary call, and the AI started speaking as usual again

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system considered the call advertising or fraud ({t}), so the AI deliberately dragged out the conversation to take up the caller's time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system considered the call advertising or fraud, so the AI deliberately dragged out the conversation to take up the caller's time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called the owner but could not reach them, and the AI told the caller the owner would call back soon; the call was not considered advertising or fraud and the conversation was not dragged out, so under "What to do" it says: call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_failed.note: Quotes the to-do label Что сделать (s_todo); keep them in step

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called the owner, who answered and was connected with the caller, and the AI left the conversation; the call was not considered advertising or fraud and the conversation was not dragged out

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said the matter was urgent, and the owner was notified right away; the call was not considered advertising or fraud and the conversation was not dragged out, so under "What to do" it says: call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_transfer.note: Quotes the to-do label Что сделать (s_todo); keep them in step

notify.n_blocked.back: A number from the blacklist called

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Declined while the call was ringing: nobody picked up, the AI did not take part

notify.n_blocked_done.back: Played "{}", call ended. The AI was not used.

notify.n_fit_adjusted.back: Bageo set up the sound of calls itself. Now it works.

notify.n_fit_failed_title.back: Problem with the sound of calls

notify.n_fit_problem.back: There is a problem with the sound of calls, all settings have already been tried. See “First use on a new phone” in the manual.

notify.n_fit_result_title.back: Result of the check of the sound of calls

notify.n_fit_test_body.back: This phone has not been checked yet. Call it from another phone and talk to the AI for about 20 seconds. After that Bageo will set up the sound of calls itself.

notify.n_fit_test_title.back: New phone: check the sound of calls

notify.n_fit_unsupported.back: This phone cannot transmit the AI's voice into calls.

notify.n_named_number.note: Written as number, dash, name because the English pattern with brackets is identical in every language and trips the untranslated check

notify.n_repeat_body.back: More calls from number {number} in the last minute: {count}. They were not sent one by one.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you see it, the notification channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_matter.back: The AI did not connect; the system hung up after about {}, the caller heard nothing

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI did not connect; the system hung up]
notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.note: English has square brackets; parentheses used instead

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI did not connect and said nothing

notify.s_call_back_if_known.back: Call back if you know this number

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the control panel

notify.s_no_service.back: The summary service is not set up

notify.s_no_summary.back: (No summary — see the transcript in the control panel.)

notify.s_no_transcript.back: The call lasted about {}; there is no usable transcript

notify.s_see_transcript.back: See the transcript in the control panel

notify.s_stall_reply.back: The conversation was dragged out for about {}; no data was given and nothing was agreed to

notify.vm_call_back_to.back: Asks to be called back: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_call_back_unchecked.back: Asks to be called back (number not verified)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Asks to be called back at this number (confirmed by pressing 1, but the number is unknown)

notify.vm_email_to.back: Asks for a reply by email: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Asks for a reply by email (confirmed by pressing 1, but the address is unknown)

notify.vm_no_choice.back: No reply method chosen (the call ended earlier)

notify.vm_no_transcript.back: Message about {} long; it could not be transcribed. Listen to the recording

notify.vm_task_failed.back: Voice message (could not be transcribed; needs a look)

notify.ap_weekdays.back: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

notify.ap_dt_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d.%m instead of English month abbreviation. Month abbreviation %b is printed by the app in English (e.g. "21 Nov") inside Russian text; should be a numeric date such as {}, %-d.%m, %H:%M.

notify.date_fmt.note: fixed: numeric day.month instead of English month abbreviation. Month abbreviation %b is printed by the app in English (e.g. "21 Nov") inside Russian text; should be a numeric day.month such as %-d.%m.

notify.dt_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d.%m instead of English month abbreviation. Month abbreviation %b is printed by the app in English (e.g. "21 Nov") inside Russian text; should be numeric such as %-d.%m, %H:%M.

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. I'm listening to you.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.go_ahead.back: Yes, of course, I'm listening to you.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I need to think about it.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, hold on, I have one more question.
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Needs a native check: 'постойте' must not read as a request to wait for the AI

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one little minute", "just a second", "I'll take a look now", "wait"
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: now only the quoted local phrases, not a full instruction sentence. Whole instruction sentence ('Never say ...') instead of only the quoted phrases; the prompt inserts it after 'lines like', so it should be just "just a sec", "give me a moment", "let me see".

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have dialed is currently unavailable. Please call back later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Ah, the courier? Fine, leave it by the door, thank you very much. / Okay, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: farewells: goodbye; all the best; have a good day; see you. wrap-ups: I have to go; we'll talk later; I'll call back. ends examples: "Okay, thanks, goodbye." / "Fine, I have to go. All the best!" / "That's it, we'll talk later, see you." not_ends examples: "Hello, my name is Oleg, I'm calling about your order." / "Before you hang up, I'll tell you the main thing: we have a promotion." / "What needs to be done before the meeting so that everything goes well?"
call.speech.closing.note: Chosen only from words already in Bageo's closing list; not verified

names.aliases.back: russkiy, russkij, russian, 'Russian language' (русский язык), rus
names.aliases.note: Includes a Latin transliteration for search

desktop.adb_failed.back: Could not download. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.adb_need.back: Android tools (about 7 MB, from Google) are needed for phones over USB.

desktop.err_addr.back: The address must start with http:// or https://.

desktop.err_save.back: Could not save some settings. Try again.

desktop.locked.back: Enter the password to see your phones.

desktop.no_phone_hint.back: Connect a phone and open the app. It will appear here.

desktop.r_all_normal.back: All phones work as regular ones

desktop.r_launch_failed.back: Bageo did not start. See bageo.log in its folder.

desktop.r_offline.back: No connection to Bageo. Is it still running?

desktop.r_phone_offline.note: Reworded to 'No connection: {name}' to avoid gender agreement with the phone name

desktop.r_setup.note: Plural form avoided by using 'Осталось заполнить настроек: {n}'

desktop.set_addr_hint.back: Leave empty to find it automatically.

desktop.set_notify_sms_old.back: For this to work, update Bageo and the SMS forwarding program.

desktop.set_notify_summary.back: When the call summary is ready

desktop.set_pw_hint.back: Needed only if your control panel has a password.

console.copy_failed.back: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

console.err_network.back: Cannot reach Bageo. Check whether it is running.

console.setup_title.back: Welcome! Three steps — and the phone answers by itself

console.setup_1_d.back: Enter your Gemini API key and your name.

console.setup_2_d.back: Connect a phone with the app via USB and wait for "Ready for calls". Then you can unplug the cable: the phone will switch to Wi-Fi on its own.

console.setup_3_d.back: Choose where to send call summaries, e.g. Telegram or Discord.

console.empty_body.back: Connect a phone and call its number. The call, summary, and recording will show up here.

console.d_pending.back: Writing summary… takes about half a minute after the call.

console.d_live.back: The call is still in progress. The summary and conversation will appear after it ends.

console.d_nosummary.back: There is no summary for this call.

console.d_src_fallback.back: The summary service didn't respond, so only a brief note is shown here.

console.d_src_nokey.back: Summary service is not set up.

console.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller never confirmed the repeated time; check with them before replying

console.ap_working.back: Processing… (up to 90 seconds when sending SMS)

console.sms_c_old_app.back: app on the phone is outdated

console.sms_c_busy.back: the same SMS is already being sent

console.sms_c_no_permission.back: the app has no permission to send SMS

console.sms_c_sim_not_found.back: selected SIM card is missing from the phone

console.cal_pick_body.back: Your choice will be saved. Click "Change" to pick another.

console.cal_hint_office365.back: Outlook with a work or school account

console.cal_hint_apple.back: iPhone, iPad, Mac: open the file and tap "Add"

console.ap_res_sms_none.back: Cannot send SMS to this number; call back yourself

console.ap_call_no_answer.back: AI called back, but nobody answered

console.ap_call_send_failed.back: No callback: the phone did not receive the request

console.ap_call_queued.back: AI will call once the previous call to this number finishes

console.ap_call_answered.back: AI got through and delivered the reply

console.ap_call_not_callable.back: No callback: this number cannot be called (international, toll-free, premium, or short number)

console.d_norec.back: There is no recording for this call.

console.tr_listen_h.back: Full conversation: caller and AI together.

console.tr_vm_h.back: Only the message left by the caller.

console.end_ai_fail.back: The AI could not connect, so the call was hung up.

console.end_voicemail.back: The AI couldn't handle it; the call went to voicemail.

console.end_hidden.back: Hidden number: played rejection message and ended the call. The AI didn't answer.

console.end_blocked.back: Blacklisted number: played unavailability message and ended the call. The AI didn't answer.

console.end_spam.back: Call flagged as sales or scam, so the AI dragged out the conversation to waste their time.

console.end_normal.back: The AI answered, spoke, and the call ended normally.

console.end_call_waiting.back: Came in during another call; the phone rejected it as busy (no AI).

console.d_block_body.back: Calls from this number will be declined. The AI won't answer them.

console.d_notfound.back: Call not found. Its retention period may have expired.

console.d_scam_none.back: Not flagged as sales or scam

console.d_scam_released.back: Initially flagged as sales or scam, then continued as a normal call

console.d_fb_q.back: Is this right? Your answer will be used for future calls from this number.

console.d_fb_done.back: Saved. We'll factor this in on future calls from this number.

console.d_fb_done_hidden.back: Saved. A hidden number cannot be remembered.

console.f_scam_blind.back: Check every call for spam and scams

console.f_scam_blind_h.back: On: catches new tricks too, using slightly more quota. Off: checks only calls with typical ad or scam words.

console.ct_search_ph.back: Search by name, number, or note

console.ct_empty_body.back: Add people manually or import from your phone, Google, or Outlook. When a call comes in, you'll see the name and the AI will know who's calling.

console.ct_note_help.back: The AI sees this during a call, e.g. "sister", "landlord", "coworker".

console.ct_delete_body.back: On calls from these numbers, only the number will be visible again.

console.ct_need_phone.back: Enter at least one phone number.

console.ct_exists.back: This number is already saved under contact {name}.

console.ct_imp_drop.back: Drag a file here or click to choose

console.ct_imp_formats.back: Supports vCard, CSV, Excel, Word, and text files. PDFs and images are read by Gemini (Gemini API key required). Up to 10 MB.

console.ct_imp_skipped.back: Entries without a name or number skipped: {n}.

console.ct_imp_none.back: No contacts with a phone number found in this file.

console.ct_imp_by_ai.back: File read by Gemini: check names and numbers before importing.

console.err_contact_exists.back: This number is already saved under another contact.

console.err_invalid_contact.back: Enter a name and at least one phone number.

console.err_too_many_contacts.back: You can save at most 10,000 contacts.

console.err_contacts_save_failed.back: Could not write contacts to disk.

console.err_need_gemini_key.back: Gemini reads such files: enter a Gemini API key in settings first.

console.err_unsupported_file.back: This format is not supported. Save the file as .xlsx, .csv, .vcf, or PDF and try again.

console.err_too_many_rows.back: File is too large (max 100,000 rows). Split it or keep only contact columns.

console.err_import_failed.back: File reading was interrupted. Try again.

console.s_meta.back: Changes take effect on the next call.

console.saved.back: Saved. Takes effect on the next call.

console.notify_follows_ui.back: Notifications are now also in {lang} ("Notification language" setting).

console.g_basics_d.back: A few details the AI needs in order to answer calls.

console.f_language_h.back: Language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: Language of notifications and summaries for you. Does not change the language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only needed when a phone has a SIM from another region: calls to that SIM open in the language you pick here. Needs the phone app 1.0 or newer.

console.sl_empty.back: Not set: all calls start in the language selected above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers call you by. The AI uses it when referring to you.

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: Foreign name, nickname, etc. One per line, up to 10. The AI will understand they refer to you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Introduces itself as your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers like you, without promising anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key on Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI communicates through. You almost never need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: Preview plays three sample lines in the language selected above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are answered and hung up right away. For your phone to ring normally, tap "Switch to normal phone" under "System" or in the app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Waits slightly before answering, like a person. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Before the limit, the AI politely says goodbye and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks right after picking up. Off: the caller waits 1–3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: the AI answers hidden numbers as usual. Off: plays an unavailability message and ends the call.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI stops speaking and listens when the caller starts talking. Doesn't work on all phones; Bageo checks automatically.

console.f_vad.back: Gemini detects when the caller finishes speaking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: detected by volume only.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: If the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_h.back: A short note on your current situation, e.g. where a courier should leave a package. The AI mentions it only when relevant.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Delivery: please leave the package at the front desk.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds quiet room sound behind the AI's voice so answers sound natural.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is clearly selling something or trying to scam.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI feigns interest and asks for details to waste time. Gives away no data and agrees to nothing. Off: politely declines and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max.back: Max length of such a call

console.f_stall_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Longer calls use more Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Blank = same model as for normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers will help the AI sound like you. Everything is optional.

console.f_prompt_h.back: If filled in, replaces speaking style and local habits. Stored separately for each role; write {owner} instead of your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, role, and name. If you just changed them, save first.

console.p_replace_body.back: There is already text in the editor. It will be replaced by the built-in instruction.

console.f_knowledge.back: Facts the AI can answer from

console.f_knowledge_ph.back: e.g. Parcels: leave at reception. Hours: Mon–Fri, 9 to 18.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Facts callers might ask about, one per line. The AI shouldn't make up anything not listed here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Plays when declining a call from the blacklist or a hidden number. The blacklist is configured in "Contacts".

console.b_help.back: Put * at the end to block all numbers starting with it, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits excluding leading zeros).

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play unavailability message, and hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement plays in the language selected above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Send a notification on an incoming call and a summary after it ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: notifications are not sent anywhere.

console.n_empty.back: No notification channels yet. Add a channel to receive call summaries on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Check calls, give the AI call errands, and manage your "To-do" list right from chat. Send /help for a list of commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group, specify who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private chat, you can leave it blank. Get your ID from @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First enable "Accept commands from this chat" on a channel above.

console.rc_env.back: Accept Telegram chat commands from environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat come from the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID environment variables. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS restricts which users are allowed to send commands.

console.rc_errands.back: AI errand calls per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no errand calls from chats. Maximum 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: Above this limit, the chat gets no replies until the minute ends.

console.mcp_desc.back: Lets AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT view your calls and to-dos. Leave off if not needed.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when enabled and a Token is set below. Address: control panel address plus /mcp.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token in your AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: Allow instructing AI to make calls?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me in chat first

console.mcp_calls_h.back: The "Ask me first" option requires a chat with commands enabled.

console.mcp_errands_h.back: Across all AI tools combined, from 0 to 30.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: For web AI tools only: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave blank.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot via @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you yours; for a group, enter the group ID and add the bot there. Message the bot once so it can message you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: enter a webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy URL) or a bot token and channel ID; either one is enough. For direct messages, enter your ID instead of the channel ID. Commands: enter the bot token, channel ID, and enable Message Content Intent.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an incoming webhook URL (works for Mattermost too) or enter a bot token and channel ID; either one is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): enable Socket Mode, enter the bot token (xoxb-), app-level token (xapp-), and channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers Console → Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify shut down in 2025; this is its replacement.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Make up a hard-to-guess topic and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave server blank for ntfy.sh. A token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, then copy the token. Server URL is your Gotify server address.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave server blank for the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get an API token. Your user key is shown on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In a WeCom group: add a group bot and copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If "Signature" security is selected, paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not enable signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan site.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), the sender account's access token, and the ID of a room that account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords), not your regular password.

console.hint_apprise.back: Notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. Tag limits recipient services.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL accepting a JSON POST with event, title, body, and data fields. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant, or custom scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: channel "…" menu → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", finish setup, and copy the generated URL. Legacy Office 365 connectors are retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open a chat → Apps & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: enable it, choose a channel, and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic), enter its email and API key as email:key. Recipient: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone) or email for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy the access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID or a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, username and app password (Settings → Security) as user:password, and the conversation token (the last part of the conversation link).

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the webhook URL. On a home network, an http:// address with port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, number in international format (+…), and recipients (numbers or group IDs separated by commas).

console.hint_pushplus.back: Sign in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends to a group; leave blank to send only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key, and copy it. Leave server blank for the public server.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login also serves as the sender address. Use an app password if available.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security), and a notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (see Developer Tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: The key is shown at ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation. Create an applet "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is title, value2 is text.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications point to this address. Blank = gray address in the field; for Docker or access away from home, enter your own.

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call, the AI writes a short summary. Usually nothing needs to be configured here.
